```{r}
library(glue)
library(dunn.test)  # install.packages("dunn.test") if needed
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)


project_dir = "~/Documents/repos/archive/brain_connectivity_in_chronic_pain"
df <- read.csv(glue("{project_dir}/Data/metadata_prepped_260313.csv"))
df <- df[df$time == 1, ]
 
# Create three-group variable: HC, LoMo CBP, HiMo CBP
df$group <- ifelse(df$is_patient == 0, "HC",
            ifelse(df$HiMo_subject == 1, "HiMo_CBP", "LoMo_CBP"))
df$group <- factor(df$group, levels = c("HC", "LoMo_CBP", "HiMo_CBP"))

# --- Current pain (spon_pain_rating_mean) ---
kruskal.test(age ~ group, data = df)
dunn.test(df$age, df$group, method = "bonferroni")
```


```{r}
library(ggpattern)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggbeeswarm)

# Significance brackets — update labels to match your Dunn's output
comparisons <- list(c("HC", "LoMo_CBP"), c("HC", "HiMo_CBP"), c("LoMo_CBP", "HiMo_CBP"))
p_labels <- c("ns", "****", "****")  # HC vs LoMo, HC vs HiMo, LoMo vs HiMo

ggplot(df, aes(x = group, y = age, fill = group)) +
  geom_violin_pattern(
    aes(pattern_fill = group),
    pattern = "circle",
    pattern_density = 0.3,
    pattern_spacing = 0.03,
    pattern_size = 0.2,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  # geom_boxplot(width = 0.08, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_beeswarm(color = "black", priority='density', size=0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("HC" = "#c8493a", "LoMo_CBP" = "#4dbfbf", "HiMo_CBP" = "#6a5acd")) +
  scale_pattern_fill_manual(values = c("HC" = "#c8493a", "LoMo_CBP" = "#4dbfbf", "HiMo_CBP" = "#6a5acd")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("HC" = "HC", "LoMo_CBP" = "LoMo CBP", "HiMo_CBP" = "HiMo CBP")) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = comparisons, label = "p.signif",
                     tip.length = 0.01,
                     step.increase = 0.08) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Current Pain Rating") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12))



library(ggpubr)
library(ggbeeswarm)
 
# Get y max for bracket placement
y_max <- max(df$spon_pain_rating_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
 
# Significance brackets from Dunn's output
comparisons <- list(c("HC", "LoMo_CBP"), c("HC", "HiMo_CBP"), c("LoMo_CBP", "HiMo_CBP"))
 
ggplot(df, aes(x = group, y = spon_pain_rating_mean, fill = group)) +
  geom_violin(
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.6,
    width = 0.7,          # narrower violins like Prism
    bw = 2                # tighter bandwidth = less smoothing, more tapered shape
  ) +
  geom_beeswarm(
    color = "black",
    size = 1.2,
    alpha = 0.8,
    cex = 0.9,            # tighter packing of points
    priority = "density"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("HC" = "#c8493a", "LoMo_CBP" = "#4dbfbf", "HiMo_CBP" = "#6a5acd")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("HC" = "HC", "LoMo_CBP" = "LoMo CBP", "HiMo_CBP" = "HiMo CBP")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.15))) +  # reduce top whitespace
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = comparisons,
    label = "p.signif",
    tip.length = 0.01,
    step.increase = 0.06,
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Current Pain Rating") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12))
 
```
